info.title: National Boundaries and Addresses API of Lithuania
info.summary: Access comprehensive data on national boundaries and addresses registered in the Republic of Lithuania
info.description:
This API provides detailed information and geometries about counties, municipalities, elderships, residential areas, streets, addresses, and rooms.
ReDoc style documentation can be found here.


This API is licensed under the [MIT License](https://github.com/govlt/national-boundaries-api#license).
Data from this API is licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). For more information, visit [Registrų centras](https://www.registrucentras.lt/p/1187).

post.summary: Search for counties with pagination using various filters
post.description: Search for counties with pagination using various filters such as county codes, feature IDs, name. Additionally, you can filter by GeoJson, EWKT geometry

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: Cursor for the next page
schema.title: Cursor

example_counties_codes.description: Retrieve data for counties by specifying county codes.

example_counties_feature_ids.description: Retrieve data for counties by specifying feature IDs.

example_counties_name_starts.description: Retrieve data for counties where names start with the specified prefix.

example_counties_name_exact.description: Retrieve data for counties matching the exact specified name.

example_counties_name_contains.description: Retrieve data for counties where names contain the specified substring.

example_ewkb.description: Filter geometries using hexed EWKB (Extended Well-Known Binary) format and the 'intersects' method. SRID inside EWKB is mandatory.

example_ewkt.description: Filter geometries using EWKT (Extended Well-Known Text) format with the default 'intersects' method. SRID inside EWKT is mandatory.

example_geojson.description: Filter geometries using GeoJSON format and the 'contains' method. CRS inside GeoJSON is mandatory.

200.description: A paginated list of counties matching the search criteria.

get.description: Retrieve a county by its unique code.

parameters.name: code

schema.description: The code of the county to retrieve
schema.title: Code

parameters.description: The code of the county to retrieve

200.description: Details of the county with the specified code.

get.summary: Get county with geometry by code
get.description: Retrieve a county along with its geometry by its unique code. Optionally specify the SRID for the geometry output.

parameters.name: code

schema.description: The code of the county to retrieve
schema.title: Code

parameters.description: The code of the county to retrieve

parameters.name: srid

schema.description: A spatial reference identifier (SRID) for geometry output.
schema.title: Srid

parameters.description: A spatial reference identifier (SRID) for geometry output.

example_wgs.description: The World Geodetic System (WGS 84) coordinate reference system.

example_lks.description: The Lithuanian Coordinate System (LKS 94) reference system.

parameters.name: geometry_output_format

schema.description: Specify the format for geometry output.

parameters.description: Specify the format for geometry output.

example_ewkt.description: Extended Well-Known Text (EWKT) format for representing geometric data.

example_ewkb.description: Extended Well-Known Binary (EWKB) format for representing geometric data.

200.description: Details of the county with the specified code, including its geometry.
